title: NTL Qwen3-14B Two-Stage Champion Backbone
subtitle: Champion Two-Stage Multi-Layer LoRA Checkpoint & Centered Heads for Qwen3-14B
description:
# Name That LLM: In-House Two-Stage LoRA Checkpoint (Qwen3-14B Champion Backbone)

Production Two-Stage Multi-Layer LoRA classifier checkpoint, dual (plain + prompt-centered) heads, and whitened spectral style bank fine-tuned on **Qwen/Qwen3-14B-Base** for the Kaggle *Name That LLM* competition.

---

## Architecture Overview
- **Base Trunk**: `Qwen/Qwen3-14B-Base` (40 transformer layers, hidden dimension $d = 5,120$)
- **Tapped Representation Layers**: Layers `[2, 4, 6, 9, 13, 17, 22, 27]` (8 intermediate layers)
- **Causal Attention Sink Masking**: Zero-masked token 0 (`m[:, 0] = 0.0`) to neutralize initial token attention concentration
- **Layer Normalization**: 8 dedicated per-layer LayerNorm modules ($d = 5,120$)
- **Feature Dimension ($Z$)**: $8 \times 5,120 = 40,960$ dimensions
- **Dual Heads**:
  - `plain.weight` / `plain.bias`: Direct sequence attribution across all 18 classes
  - `centered.weight` / `centered.bias`: Prompt-mean subtracted ($Z_c = Z - \bar{Z}_{\text{prompt}}$) feature attribution
- **Training Loss**: Composite Two-Stage Loss (Supervised Contrastive + Family-Margin Cross-Entropy $m=0.45$)
- **Classes ($K$)**: Master canonical 18 LLM classes
- **Pre-trained Head Verification**: BAcc = **0.7362** on local prompt holdout benchmark

---

## Files Included
- `heads.safetensors`: Dual classification heads (40,960 -> 18) and 8 intermediate LayerNorm weights (20 keys total)
- `adapter/`: Full HuggingFace/PEFT LoRA adapter weights (`adapter_model.safetensors`, `adapter_config.json`, $r=32, \alpha=64$)
- `wPCA_bank.npz`: Whitened PCA covariance bank ($40,960 \rightarrow 256$ dimensions)
- `meta.json`: Checkpoint provenance, layer indices, and feature dimensionalities
- `stage2_cv_report.json`: 5-fold cross-validation performance report
- `data_audit_report.json`: Clean dataset hash audit confirming 0% test leakage
